rawContent: Absolutely devastating seeing the bushfires at home on #SouthCoastNSW. Family can’t get out & apparently have to evacuate to the beach if it gets worse. Huge thanks to all of our volunteer firefighters working to keep them safe #NSWfires #ClimateEmergency #AustralianFires

The thing about the new Lib Party catchphrase “quiet Australians” is that, by definition, they don’t express opinions so you can give them whatever opinion you like & quote it in support of whatever arrant nonsense you spout. Meanwhile... #AustraliaBurns #ClimateEmergency #auspol

My heart breaks seeing these pictures of beautiful places at home in #Shoalhaven #SouthCoastNSW, where I grew up, wiped out by fire. We are past time for decisive climate action & improve emergency response. Get it together @ScottMorrisonMP #climatecrisis #auspol #bushfirecrisis

An image of the #AustraliaFires devastation in #Shoalhaven, #SouthCoastNSW - where I grew up - on front page of major UK newspapers.
